title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. This works just ok for me. It gets the job done but requires a bit of force and sometimes doesn’t so straight down. Quick to use and my kids love sliced apples.

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Apple Corer Slicer, Stainless Steel Blades Apple Cutter, Sharp Apple Peeler, Pitter, Divider (L, Green)
features: 【High Quality Safety Apple Corer】 : Apple Corer is made of high quality food grade stainless steel, acid and alkali resistance, corrosion resistance, not easy to rust, clean use more assured. Sharp blade cutting can easily remove fruit pits. Sharp blade
【Easy to Use】: This apple cutter slicer corer has a simple structure and sharp blades, you can easily cut the fruit into 8 pieces with just one press.

【Easy Cleaning】: Warm water or dishwasher can clean the slicer. Please clean it with cleaning brush, wipe it with a rag or air-dry it to prolong the life of the product after use. The blade is very sharp. Please take care to prevent injuries to hands and keep away from children.

【Ergonomic Design & Good Grip】: Premium quality apple corer is specially designed for ease of use and hold. The thick, soft, rubber handle fits perfectly in your hand, and gives you the excellent grip while the sharp, serrated stainless steel blade makes removing cores a breeze! Dishwasher safe, simply wipe under running water or put them in the dishwasher.
【Practical Design】: The shape of this apple corer handle conforms to the ergonomic design, and this apple cutter handle is made of new materials, which is light and strong.
